description.zh: 从空白模板开始：只包含一份可编辑的 AGENTS.md，可按需添加技能和子智能体。
description.en: Start from a blank template with a single editable AGENTS.md. Add skills and subagents as needed.

welcome_message.zh: 无论工作还是生活，说出你的想法
welcome_message.en: Share what's on your mind — work or life

zh: 每个工作日「09:00」列出今日待办并按优先级排序，任务创建后立即启用
每周日「20:00」复盘本周完成事项，并给出下周计划
每天「22:00」提醒我整理明天要处理的三件事，从今天开始持续生效
en: Every weekday at 09:00, list today's todos ranked by priority — enable immediately
Every Sunday at 20:00, recap what got done this week and outline next week's plan
Every day at 22:00, remind me to pick the three things to handle tomorrow — start today and keep running

description.en: State the goal and start now

prompt.zh: 请帮我完成下面这项任务。先看工作区里已有的材料，缺的信息再问我：
prompt.en: Help me complete this task. Check the workspace first, and ask only for what is still missing:

description.zh: 先拆步骤、材料和交付物

prompt.zh: 请先不要动手改文件。根据下面的目标写一份计划：步骤、需要的材料、完成标准。目标是：
prompt.en: Don't change files yet. Write a plan for this goal: steps, materials, and what done looks like.

description.zh: 梳理问题、风险和优先级

prompt.zh: 请根据下面的情况，列出问题、风险和优先处理顺序，不要编造我没提供的事实：
prompt.en: From the situation below, list the issues, risks, and what to handle first. Don't invent facts I didn't provide:

description.zh: 按要求给出可直接使用的成品

prompt.zh: 请直接给出可使用的结果，结论放前面。我的要求和材料是：
prompt.en: Produce a ready-to-use result, with the conclusion first. My request and materials are:

description.zh: 按反馈改一版，保留原意
description.en: Revise a draft without changing the intent

prompt.zh: 请优化下面的内容：先说你会改什么，再给出改后的全文。原文是：
prompt.en: Refine the draft below: say what you will change, then give the full revised text.

description.zh: 把规矩记下来，下次直接用
description.en: Save a rule and use it next time

prompt.zh: 请记住这个偏好，之后同类任务直接照做，不要再问一遍：
prompt.en: Remember this preference and apply it next time without asking again:
